entries.message: uuid@10 and below is no longer supported.  For ESM codebases, update to uuid@latest.  For CommonJS codebases, use uuid@11 (but be aware this version will likely be deprecated in 2028).
entries.rationale: Firebase Admin's optional Cloud Storage client still selects uuid 9; forcing a semver-major transitive override would bypass the owner's compatibility contract.

entries.message: Use your platform's native DOMException instead
dependencyPaths: server > @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node@0.79.0 > @opentelemetry/resource-detector-gcp@0.56.0 > gcp-metadata@8.1.4 > gaxios@7.1.3 > node-fetch@3.3.2 > fetch-blob@3.2.0 > node-domexception@1.0.0
gateway > firebase-admin@13.10.0 > google-auth-library@10.7.0 > gaxios@7.1.5 > node-fetch@3.3.2 > fetch-blob@3.2.0 > node-domexception@1.0.0
entries.rationale: Both current direct owners inherit node-fetch 3's deprecated DOMException shim through Google-maintained packages; the runtime uses Node 24's native DOMException where application code controls the boundary.

entries.message: Old versions of glob are not supported, and contain widely publicized security vulnerabilities, which have been fixed in the current version. Please update. Support for old versions may be purchased (at exorbitant rates) by contacting i@izs.me
entries.rationale: The current OpenTelemetry line inherits rimraf 5 and glob 10 from its Google Cloud detector; overriding glob across tool boundaries would be broader than the warning source.

entries.message: This package is now rolled into @stellar/stellar-sdk. Please use @stellar/stellar-sdk to continue receiving updates and support.
entries.rationale: The latest Trezor Connect release owns the Stellar SDK graph; removing or overriding its internal Stellar package would bypass Trezor's tested hardware-wallet dependency set.

entries.message: 🚨 This package has been deprecated in favor of separate inclusion of a polyfill and regenerator-runtime (when needed). See the @babel/polyfill docs (https://babeljs.io/docs/en/babel-polyfill) for more information.
entries.rationale: The current Caravan Bitcoin release directly depends on the retired Babel polyfill; the isolated vector verifier cannot replace a library-internal runtime dependency safely.

entries.message: core-js@<3.23.3 is no longer maintained and not recommended for usage due to the number of issues. Because of the V8 engine whims, feature detection in old core-js versions could cause a slowdown up to 100x even if nothing is polyfilled. Some versions have web compatibility issues. Please, upgrade your dependencies to the actual version of core-js.
entries.rationale: The current Caravan Bitcoin release directly depends on core-js 2 inside an isolated verification tool; a forced replacement would not validate Caravan's compiled output contract.
